verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a brief docs note that you can 'write your own' providers via the /terraform/plugin developer section, which implies an official plugin-development kit but never names or describes an SDK. The CLI, JSON output and MCP server are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs (provider/plugin SDK, client libraries for the HCP Terraform API, language SDKs), their supported languages and maturity, an OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
